lines.text: Many learners say: I live near from my school.
Better: I live near my school.
Near already means close to, so do not add from.
Near! I live near my school.

data.wrong: I live near from my school.
data.why: Near already means close to, so do not add from.

native.tip: ‘학교에서 가까워요’의 ‘에서’ 때문에 near from이라고 말하기 쉬워요. near 뒤에는 from이 필요 없어요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I live near my school.”
native.caption: “I live near from my school.”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 ‘학교에서 가까워요’의 ‘에서’ 때문에 from을 붙이기 쉬워요. near는 그 자체로 ‘~에서 가까이’라는 뜻이라서 from이 필요 없어요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I live near my school.” Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.

en.tip: Near already means close to, so do not add from. Say “I live near my school.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “I live near from my school.” Near already means close to, so do not add from. Right: “I live near my school.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
